test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Come". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "(3) alive" requires a verb that will indicate the learning material becomes or appears alive to the students.
 
• **"Come alive"** is a commonly used idiomatic expression that means to become energized or exciting.
 
• In pedagogical context, **"come alive" **means making study material more interesting, engaging, and memorable.
 
• In this context, **"come" **is the most appropriate word to use.
 
• The phrase "come alive" implies that the props such as notes, handouts, or slides used by the teacher will invigorate the learning material, making it more engaging and memorable for the students.
 
• So, the sentence should read: **"So, the teacher must have props like notes, handouts, and slides that will make the learning material come alive for the students and stay that way with them."**

Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 4". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Stay alive" might seem appropriate at first, but it is typically used to denote survival, not transformation into a livelier state.
 
• "Depart alive" doesn't make sense because "depart" means to leave, which connotes movement away, not transformation or enhancement.
 
• "Go alive" also doesn't fit well because "go" conveys movement from one place to another rather than transformation.
